content.text:
**BIS Hanoi (British International School Hanoi) graduates go to universities worldwide, with the United States as the most popular destination and the UK second.** Between 2016 and 2026, graduates were accepted by more than 400 universities. Australia, Canada, and parts of Asia (especially Hong Kong, South Korea, and Singapore) are also common; some students go to continental Europe or stay in Vietnam.

### Notable destinations by region
The school highlights places at top institutions such as:

- **United States**: Stanford, Yale, Columbia, Princeton, NYU, UCLA, UC Berkeley, Brown, Duke, Johns Hopkins, Boston University, and USC, among others. Arts pathways include Berklee College of Music, Parsons (The New School), Savannah College of Art and Design, and Rhode Island School of Design.
- **United Kingdom**: Cambridge, Imperial College London, UCL, LSE, King’s College London, Manchester, Edinburgh, Warwick, Bristol, and Durham, plus creative options such as the University of the Arts London.
- **Canada**: University of Toronto, University of British Columbia, and McGill.
- **Australia**: University of Melbourne, University of Sydney, UNSW, and Monash.
- **Asia**: University of Hong Kong, HKUST, Chinese University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, KAIST, Seoul National University, Yonsei, and Korea University; also Waseda in Japan.
- **Europe**: Examples include Bocconi (Italy) and the University of Amsterdam, with places also reported in France, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.

### Recent cohorts
The Class of 2026 received offers including Yale, Cambridge, UCL, UC Berkeley, LSE, King’s College London, Toronto, Melbourne, KAIST, and the University of Hong Kong, plus arts schools such as Berklee and the University of the Arts London. The school has also reported that 35% of one recent Year 13 cohort received offers from QS Top 50 universities (examples cited include Yale, Cambridge, Stanford, Yonsei, and NUS). The Class of 2025 received more than 150 offers, including UCL, Edinburgh, King’s, Boston University, Sydney, Hong Kong, and Waseda.

These figures come mainly from the school’s own reporting of offers and acceptances (students typically hold multiple offers). For the fullest lists, see the school’s [university destinations page](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/academic-excellence/university-destinations) and its college profile documents.
